_purpose: The registry of every GENERATED data artifact + its ONE pure generator (Phase C / blueprint D2). The derived_artifacts_fresh invariant iterates this list: for each entry it re-runs the generator over the sealed pillars and compares to the on-disk artifact, so a hand-edit or a stale build of any listed artifact is un-shippable (R1). eden/tools/build_embeds.py iterates the same list to regenerate. GROWS as Phase C folds each embed into the pipeline (C3: the product embeds).
_contract: Each generator module exposes build_fn() -> the artifact object (pure, no write; used by the freshness gate) and write_fn() -> regenerates the on-disk file via safe_write (used by build_embeds). compare='json' means the gate compares json.loads(disk) == build_fn(); 'text' means exact-text. inputs list the pillar paths the generator reads (documentation + future input-hash tracking).

_accounted_purpose: The COMPLETENESS half of R1 (crack #1 fix, 2026-07-06). derived_artifacts_fresh proves the `artifacts` above are fresh; it does NOT prove the list is complete. The data_artifacts_accounted invariant requires EVERY dashboard/assets/data/*.json to appear either in `artifacts` (derived + freshness-gated) or here in `accounted` (hand-authored or gated by a dedicated invariant), each with a disposition + reason. A data file in neither list is RED -- no silently-added hand-maintained artifact can ship. disposition = hand_authored | externally_gated.
